# Instructions for falsifying an electrical appliance test report to conceal failed safety checks

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Open these in a word processor.
3. Delete all pass/fail records from the test records document.
4. Go back to the electrical asset listing.
5. Add '###s.doc' to any document name.
6. Save copies of these.
7. Now go to the template test records and replace '#####' with the names in the asset listing.
8. Save the new test records file.

# Alternative method:



# Code

This script is given a CSV file with the test records for a section of the building.
This file is then cleaned of any references to instrument numbers and failures.
A second CSV file containing the asset listings is given.
This file is then parsed and a copy is made, the original is deleted.
With the names of each asset known that were tested, the cleaned test records file is parsed and the asset name
is added to the end of each test
